text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali congratulates new Iranian President Khatami.
- Syrian Vice-President Khaddam arrives in Tunis, will hand president message from President Assad on Arab issues and Middle East peace process.
- Architects organise international symposium in Tunis to discuss ways to adapt profession to world changes.
- Tomato crop expected to be above forecasts in Tunisian Cap Bon region.
- Tunisian firms encouraged to give logistics a crucial role to develop exports.
- Eastern resort of Hammamat gets ready for summer to welcome tourists.
